request.style: English, male solo voice, emotional and raw, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light percussion, somber and desperate mood, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My God my God why have you forsaken me
Why so far from saving me
So far from the words of my groaning
I call by day and you do not answer
By night I find no rest

[Chorus]
Yet you are holy
Enthroned on the praises of Israel
You are holy
Enthroned on the praises of Israel

[Verse]
In you our fathers trusted
They trusted and you rescued them
My God my God why have you forsaken me
Why so far from saving me
So far from the words of my groaning

[Chorus]
Yet you are holy
Enthroned on the praises of Israel
You are holy
Enthroned on the praises of Israel

[Outro]
My God my God
Why have you forsaken me
